title: Whombat (v0.9.0)

author.name: mbsantiago
author.field: Bioacoustics / audio annotation for machine learning

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Register a folder of audio recordings, cut them into clips for annotation tasks, draw time-frequency boxes on spectrograms and tag them with species labels, track progress, explore the annotated events, and export the project as AOEF JSON for ML training. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
